verdict.rationale: Square's official MCP server lets an agent run Square API calls through `make_api_request`, over a service catalog that includes catalog and checkout. That makes agent-driven creation of catalog items and a checkout plausible in one session. However, the pack never explicitly documents creating a product with a price, or generating a payment link, as a workflow. Missing for 10: explicit docs for creating catalog items/variations with prices, explicit payment-link (Checkout API) documentation, an end-to-end agent provisioning example, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: over a service catalog spanning payments, checkout, catalog, inventory, customers, orders, invoices
